messages:
nina-sales: Customer asked for pen-test report + vuln scan evidence + SIG/CAIQ mapping for their vendor intake. Can we assemble a sanitized bundle and give a timeline?

nina-sales: Uploaded initial files: <https://files.redwood.com/share/pen_test_q1_2026_redacted.pdf|pen_test_q1_2026_redacted.pdf> and <https://files.redwood.com/share/vulnscan_2026-03-30.zip|vulnscan_2026-03-30.zip>

secops-bot: Files uploaded. Access: customer-sme@acme.com (view only). Audit id u-2026-889.

mira-sec: I validated redaction (no PII). Quick summary from scan: 5 findings total — 2 medium, 3 low. One medium requires vendor patch (runtime-crypto), other medium is nginx config we can fix.

ron-eng: Owners: nginx config -> ron-eng (INF-4332), runtime-crypto -> lee-runtime (vendor patch). I'll prepare the nginx fix and aim to deploy 2026-04-10.

vendor-relations: I'll ping the upstream vendor for the crypto patch and push for ETA.

customer-sme: We need re-scan evidence and mapping to SIG/CAIQ control IDs for our vendor tool (CSV). Also signed attestation after the re-scan.

mira-sec: Plan:
- 2026-04-10: nginx prod rollout (owner ron-eng)
- 2026-04-14: vendor patch expected (vendor-relations to confirm)
- 2026-04-16: canary verification + smoke tests
- 2026-04-18: internal re-scan (job rs-2026-631)
- 2026-04-19: package evidence + signed attestation + CSV mapping -> send to customer

ron-eng: Verification snippet we'll run post-deploy:
```
./tools/run_vuln_check --target nginx-gateway --find FIND-2026-334
```

secops-bot: Re-scan job scheduled: rs-2026-631 on 2026-04-18 02:30 UTC. Results posted to /sec/runs/rs-2026-631.

mira-sec: I'll produce CSV with columns: find_id,cve,control_id,control_family,remediation_status. Example: FIND-2026-334,CVE-2026-2001,CC-7.1,Configuration Management,in_progress

nina-sales: I'll be the procurement contact and will send the bundle once we have the re-scan + signed attestation. Thanks team.
